map.因为在遍历的同时增删元素会改变索引，导致漏掉元素或越界。正确做法是遍历副本（fo: Because adding or removing elements while iterating shifts the indices, which can make you skip items or run past the end. The correct approaches are to iterate over a copy (for x in lst[:]), build a new list with a comprehension, or delete in reverse order. Also beware of mutable default arguments (such as def f(a=[])), which are shared across calls — another very common trap.
